description: This Java class 'LoanWorkbookPopulator' is responsible for populating an Excel workbook with loan data templates, including sheets for office, client, group, personnel, product, charge, and extras. It sets up sheet layouts, data validation rules, named ranges, and default formulas to facilitate bulk import of loan information within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: Class responsible for populating an Excel workbook with loan import templates, including setting up layout, data validation, named ranges, and default formulas for bulk loan data import.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook with loan sheet and associated data validation rules, layouts, and lookup tables.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation constraints for various columns in the loan sheet including dropdowns and date constraints.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Initializes the header row and configures column widths and styles for the loan sheet.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Fills initial cells with formulas and default values to facilitate data entry and validation.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges for lookup data such as offices, charges, products, and dynamically generated names for each product and charge.
